subject: app-rdef
title: (P)APP.RDEF.------INFO.F.D.
description: Chart on book p. 206 (T(IMP)M-4). APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) is the subject, with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion"; INFO-F-D (information focus distortion) is the partner. From the subject: PRI-INT, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality). PHY-U-C (physical universe context) is on a dotted line from the subject. From PRI-INT: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From INDIV-DY-RT: MT-INFO-DB. From MT-INFO-DB: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From MTA-RT-SIGN: a second SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
